items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson listed as full participant in Wednesday practice, first full session since ankle injury; has missed past three games.
items.why: First full practice since injury; Rapoport confirms first full since ankle.
items.implication: Expected to play vs Bills; unlocks Ravens offense.
items.opportunity: Boost to Flowers YPRR ceiling, Henry, Andrews usage with healthy Lamar.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) listed non-participants Wednesday.
items.why: Shoulder for Gibbs, ankle for St. Brown post-Packers; Campbell indicated rest possible but availability not in jeopardy.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday practice; both likely play vs Vikings but watch volume.
items.opportunity: If either limited/out, Montgomery or Jameson Williams/LaPorta expand.

items.text: Eagles place RB Dameon Pierce on IR, sign RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.why: Corresponding move after claim/sign; Rapoport confirms.
items.implication: Clears backup path; Barkley primary with Gainwell.
items.opportunity: Kenny Gainwell handcuff/role solidifies if Barkley limited.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Eligible/returning from chest IR; practice window open, status TBD for CHI.
items.implication: Monitor snaps; committee risk with Charbonnet/Wilson.
items.opportunity: Rookie pedigree could reclaim carries if cleared fully.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest.
items.why: NIR-rest/ankle; believed maintenance, expected available vs Titans.
items.implication: Should return to practice; no major concern for Week 8 start.
items.opportunity: If sits, Higgins/Chase Brown routes/targets rise.

items.text: Silva/Levitan: time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield.
items.why: Return from IR, led snaps/usage; Payton wants more touches.
items.implication: Coleman emerging lead; Harvey/Dobbins committee lose share.
items.opportunity: Coleman RB2 upside; reverse prior handcuffs.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, shaded coverage, few threats, stadium knowing the ball is going to him.
items.why: Massive overperformance on opportunity; talent overcoming scheme/coverage.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 ceiling even in tougher setups; hold/start confidently.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated chest, DNP Wednesday; status vs Chiefs TBD later week.
items.why: Aggravated in win over ARI; Rapoport notes status TBD.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Doyle/Lamar unlock.
items.why: Elite efficiency holds with backup QB; full Lamar multiplies.
items.implication: Massive Week 8+ ceiling boost with Lamar full.
items.opportunity: Target/route share + YAC explode with mobile QB.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Give me Olave. I’d rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer selling proven but volatile Olave over unproven Tyson.
items.implication: Trade candidate if value high; Tyson stash preferred.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be big day vs Vikings defense that will pressure Goff.
items.why: Matchup pressure on Goff funnels to TE; keep flexible.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/targets rise if WRs limited or coverage soft.

items.text: Texans claimed former Cowboys RB Emari Demercado on waivers; corresponding Noel (toe) to IR.
items.why: Roster move adds depth RB; Noel season-ending toe.
items.implication: Minimal immediate fantasy; depth for Houston backfield.
items.opportunity: If primary RBs hurt, Demercado handcuff.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (calf) limited participant Wednesday.
items.implication: Likely plays but volume watch vs matchup.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2, Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4, LaPorta TE6, Jamo WR24 despite defensive woes/schedule.
items.why: Concentration + talent + schedule driving elite production.
items.implication: Continue prioritizing Lions skill players ROS/start.
items.opportunity: Gibbs RB1 lock; others high-floor with volume.
items.conflict: DNP statuses this week introduce short-term risk.
